name: history-note-bounded-reads
goal: Read large Git note sets without collecting every blob in one batch while preserving each note and revision.

evidence: Reading the preserved history loads 1,620 note blobs and 79,797 entries; the current all() requests every blob together and the isolated diagnostic observed 749,043,712 bytes process RSS after loading.

The existing notes-alone order case uses only two commits and does not constrain a large all() read. Extend that same case with a disposable many-note Git fixture and pinned-revision checks; do not add a test.
Committed test b301644345; red record 3ffaf20f7a3c failed because one payload requested 130 blobs instead of at most 64.
b7e48fe6ca parses at most 64 note blobs per Git payload while retaining original order and pinned revisions.
Red 759a041a055f and green 56749ce13b8f used the identical command, tests, runtime and environment; the unchanged case passed at b7e48fe6ca.
